descriptionMarkdown: A ship made to go to aquilo and back reliably. Uses rare materials! Use Fulgora to get all materials in rare quality. You can send the ship out ASAP, as it'll eventually get all the materials it needs. It takes roughly 30 min to start up once built. Delete the passenger present circuit condition if you do not personally plan to go to aquilo!
title: Swifts Aquilo Ship
